  Jis ko kehte haiṅ zindagi ki sada
  Hai jigar gosha-e-Nabi ki sada

  1
  Sar-e-darbaar khutba-e-Zainab
  Yuṅ samajh lo ke thi Ali ki sada

  2
  Ruh-e-Islam sajda-e-Shabbir

  3

  4

  5

  6

  8

  9

  10
